text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap and Inari One are eating
together
during lunch break.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You leveled that heaping plate in no
time flat.
Seems your appetite's as
impressive as ever!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Hey, enough with the flattery... I was just
thinking
about having some curry as my
next course.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: It wasn't a compliment, ya idiot... Wait, you're gonna eat even more?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Isn't your trainer gonna get mad at ya for
eating
all that? There's a race just
around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer... You don't think I eat too
much, do
you?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Oh. Maybe I really do eat too much...
choice_data_list: 腹が減っては力が出ない！
choice_data_list_en: Moderation is best when it comes to meals.
Can't muster any power on an empty stomach!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yep, you gotta keep a nice balance!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I guess you're right. One last plate, then
I'll call it
a day.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Didja not hear what I just said?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I'd never be able to run on
an empty
stomach!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta eat my fill so I can smash this
next race!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I think I get why Oguri chose you as her
trainer
now...
